name: Mark A. Caro
office: City of Azusa, Member of the City Council, 1st District

items.text: Mark A. Caro works in supply management. His campaign says he has served on the Villa Azusa Homeowners Association board for more than 10 years.

sentences.text: Mark A. Caro works in supply management.
His campaign says he has served on the Villa Azusa Homeowners Association board for more than 10 years.

items.text: His campaign has proposed improving safety and management in District 1, ending speeding on Sierra Madre Avenue and repairing a crossing beacon. He has also proposed revisiting the Athens amendment contract.
